title: An integer multiplicity triple essentially carried by a compact set can be moved to a larger domain
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U, V ⊆ ℝ^P, and K ⊆ ℝ^P compact with K ⊆ V and K ⊆ U. Let R = (M, θ, ξ) be an IMRep of V (Simon 6.3.1 data in V) with Hⁿ(M ∖ K) = 0, where Hⁿ = μHE[n]. Then there is an IMRep R' of U with R'.carrier ⊆ K and R'.action ω = R.action ω for every n-form ω on ℝ^P. One can take R' = (M ∩ K, θ, ξ).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U V K : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep V n), IsCompact K → K ⊆ V → K ⊆ U → μHE[n] (R.carrier \ K) = 0 → ∃ R' : IMRep U n, R'.carrier ⊆ K ∧ ∀ ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n, R'.action ω = R.action ω
